exclusions.name: Other council members
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns Councilmember Reyes's reading of the study; others' actions are irrelevant.

exclusions.name: Technical failures (e.g., email system outage)
exclusions.why_safe: No evidence suggests any such failure; city email delivers within about a minute (e9). Excluding rare outages is safe because they are not indicated.

exclusions.name: Reyes's staff reading the study on her behalf
exclusions.why_safe: The resolution note requires Reyes herself to have noticed and read the study; staff reading does not count.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether the external reviewer delivers the sign-off by 10:00 AM on 18 February as committed, or later, or not at all.
Whether Santos actually emails the study within an hour after receiving sign-off, given his documented practice but potential for delay or failure.
Whether Reyes checks her email at a time after the study is delivered and before the meeting starts, given her stated schedule but possible deviations.
Whether Reyes actually reads the study in full after receiving it, given her stated policy but potential for not having time or choosing not to read.
